item.title: Philippines Offshore Industry Grows to $42 Billion as AI Agents Create Higher-Value Work
item.summary: The Philippines' IT-BPM offshoring sector has grown to $42 billion in revenue and 1.9 million workers since ChatGPT's launch — a 30% and 20% increase respectively — as Filipino workers take on higher-value tasks including AI model training and agent supervision, according to The Economist.
